The new `add_members` action unconditionally iterates `usernames.split(",")` and calls `group.add(user)` for each found user, then `group.save` (no explicit dedup/guard in this diff). In `spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb`, the added tests cover adding multiple *distinct* users and automatic-group rejection, but do not cover the edge case of adding a user who is already a member.
